title: Console sign-in with phone number and password shows 'Invalid phone number or password.' for an account with two-factor on, instead of the code prompt
body:
qa#2 · os-bob · session_012dn2Acf5wtyrf2yKWCThBj

QA-source: #32102 · identity-auth.auth-method-matrix · observed beside the clauses

Found off-clause by the QA run #32102 (subject `ff04ad81`).

## Reproduction

1. Boot `os dev` (stock showcase) with `OS_AUTH_PHONE_NUMBER_ENABLED=true` and `OS_AUTH_TWO_FACTOR=true`.
2. As `phone.demo@example.com` (password `showcase123`), call `POST /api/v1/auth/two-factor/enable {"password":"showcase123"}`, then `POST /api/v1/auth/two-factor/verify-totp` with a current code.
3. Open `/_console/login` anonymously. In "Email or phone number" enter `+8613800138000`, with password `showcase123`. The phone-only card (email+password off) behaves the same.
4. Click Sign In. The server answers `POST /api/v1/auth/sign-in/phone-number` 200 `{"twoFactorRedirect":true,"twoFactorMethods":["totp"]}` and sets a `better-auth.two_factor` cookie. The card shows "Invalid phone number or password." and stays on sign-in.

Reproduced on 2 fresh loads. Control: the same account signing in by its email reaches "Enter the 6-digit code from your authenticator app."

**Expected:** the two-factor code prompt, as on the email path.

## Mechanism

`ui/packages/auth/src/createAuthClient.ts`, `signInWithPhonePassword` (around line 858), throws "Invalid phone number or password." whenever the response lacks a token or user. It never checks `twoFactorRedirect`. The email path, `signIn` (around line 566, #29105), turns that flag into `{ twoFactor: { methods } }`.

Owning package: `@object-ui/auth`.
